briefings.title: Former Binance CEO Speaks: From Crypto's Richest Man to Prison
briefings.tldr: Former Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao (CZ) details his transition from the head of the world's largest crypto exchange to a federal inmate, addressing his $4.3 billion DOJ settlement, his controversial presidential pardon, and his new focus on global education philanthropy.

briefings.title: Binance Co-CEO: What's Next for Binance in 2026? Richard Teng on Milestones, Trends & Market Outlook
briefings.tldr: Binance has surpassed 300 million users and $34 trillion in trading volume, signaling a shift into the "invisibility era" where blockchain technology becomes the underlying architecture for global finance, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, and payments for agentic AI.

briefings.title: Binance CEO: 4 Months in Prison, $4 Billion Fine, and What Comes Next
briefings.tldr: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) details his journey from a modest immigrant upbringing in Canada to the pinnacle of the crypto industry, emphasizing how his early experiences—from flipping burgers at McDonald's to self-funding his education—shaped the resilience and "normalcy" that define his approach to business and leadership.
